name: @genoffice/project-host
description: GenOffice Project shared host binding (PROJECT-028) — the ONE host controller both shells consume: the renderer session/view-state/projection pipeline binding @genoffice/project-renderer-core to the canonical engine, scheduler, and file adapters, the DOM rendering layer, the keyboard/menu translation tables, the document open/save composition, and the host-neutral transport bridge contract (implemented by the Electron preload on desktop and the web bridge in the browser). Host layer, NOT a foundation package: DOM APIs are its job; Electron/Node APIs are forbidden (architecture-lock §3/§13 — the discipline suite enforces it).
